notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put the Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax at least twice.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
